newsitem.title: TUNISIA: SOCCER-FORMER JUVENTUS COACH MAIFREDI QUITS TUNIS CLUB.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FORMER JUVENTUS COACH MAIFREDI QUITS TUNIS CLUB.

text.p: Former Juventus coach Gigi Maifredi has quit after just a few weeks as boss of top Tunisian side Esperance.
Maifredi's departure follows disagreements with club officials, sources said on Wednesday.

Maifredi, who made his name by taking Bologna to the first division in the late 1980s, was in charge of Juventus during the 1990-91 season when they finished seventh. He also coached Genoa and Brescia.
Former Esperance captain Khaled Ben Yahia has been named as Maifredi's replacement.
